horoscope: Retrograde Mercury continues to transit your solar eighth house, dear Aries, bringing a need to review your financial commitments and shared resources. With a New Moon occurring in this same sector of your chart early today, you’re also ready to take charge of your life in these areas. The week ahead can be excellent for breaking a bad habit, even if it’s an attitude or superstition that you’ve been clinging to. The emphasis now is on ridding yourself of burdens. It might involve eliminating some debt or clutter, or it might go deeper than that. Your insight into what aspects of yourself you need to transform is compelling now. As the day advances, you’re in especially great shape for spirited connecting. Past relationships can be in strong focus.

The need for a fresh start emerges today with a New Moon in your opposing sign, dear Taurus. Changes are in the works, but it’s better to reflect and intuit than to make plans that might fall through as new information comes to light in the coming weeks. Mercury is retrograde in the same sector as this New Moon for four more days, and you may need to look back before moving forward. Negotiations and one-to-one relationships are highlighted, and any inner unrest or a feeling that matters are out of your control related to your close personal relationships is now replaced with a sense that you’re ready to take charge. You’re likely to move in a new direction or towards a new, enlightened perspective in the coming weeks. Your vision for your relationship needs is powerful now. As the day advances, your interactions are particularly creative and notable. It's a time of a new look at past problems.

Retrograde Mercury in your work and health sector points to some backtracking around health, work, and daily routines, dear Gemini. However, a New Moon occurs in the same sector of your chart early today, bringing a sense that you’re beginning anew in these areas. As you look back on these matters, you’re also looking forward, which gives you an unusual and compelling vision for work, health, and self-care programs. Your energy and motivation to refine a health or fitness regimen, reorganize your home or workspace from top to bottom, or dive into an old work project can be strong. It’s an excellent time to edit and improve. Improved daily routines help in many areas of life, and it’s a good idea to tweak current projects and ideas rather than start all-new ones. You’ll want to breathe new life into old routines or approach your routines in a new way. Perhaps due to a dilemma experienced this week, a reinvigoration process begins now, and this is a time to start anew. Today's energies are also strong and motivating for creative projects or communications.

Today’s New Moon can serve as a powerful prompt to take charge of your life, dear Cancer, particularly in terms of happiness, self-expression, entertainment, and fulfillment. It can be a passionate time for you, especially with a Venus-Mars transit tying into the energy. Still, there can also be some related confusion or the need for patience as the story unfolds, since Mercury is retrograde in the same area of your solar chart as this New Moon. This New Moon stirs your creativity and highlights romantic inclinations as well as your need to celebrate, enjoy yourself, or express yourself in satisfying ways. Feelings and connections can be a little complicated right now. Events now can motivate a restart or reinvigoration of a project, hobby, or your dating life.

Mercury’s retrograde in your home sector these days can point to past problems resurfacing for review, dear Leo. There are only four days left of this retrograde cycle, in fact, and it's a good time to revise plans and rework old projects. However, the New Moon early today occurs in the same sector of your solar chart, stirring a burst of energy and motivation to take charge of home and family matters. You're strongly focused on improving these areas of your life now and in the coming weeks. You may be especially interested in reorganizing your home, routines, and home environment. The major focus with family can be on looking to the past to improve the present and the future. This lunation can have the effect of pushing an emotional reset button. There could be a previously neglected area of your life that now seems necessary to revisit. Living arrangements and conditions might be overdue for a change.

A fresh start is in the offing, dear Virgo, with a New Moon in your communications sector early today. You can feel motivated to approach your daily tasks in new ways. A new beginning may arise around personal interests, studies, or commuting, or you may adopt a new attitude that helps you connect more effectively with the world around you. Improving your communication skills or taking bigger risks with learning and communicating may be in focus. Since Mercury is retrograde in this same sector of your solar chart for four more days, this can be a time to express yourself in new ways or through alternate channels, and some backtracking may be involved. However, important information may be missed or missing. It’s a little too soon to know which ideas will take hold and which ideas will be left behind. However, there is no need to worry about the difference between the two yet. Instead, aim to enjoy the process and don’t push yourself. The important thing is that your curiosity is stirring.

You can feel the need or desire to start fresh, dear Libra, with today’s New Moon occurring in your resources sector. New beginnings can be in the cards related to your finances, possessions, or issues of self-respect. You’ll want to treat yourself better, and you could discover better ways to manage your money and things in the weeks ahead! Mind you, with Mercury retrograde in the same sector of your solar chart for four more days, there can be some delays, backtracking, or complications to manage before overt progress happens. It will be helpful to review recent developments and focus on building and developing your resources. Consider ways to improve your financial position and boost your sense of security. In the coming weeks, your efforts towards these ends are likely to be rewarded. Right now, ideas come to you in flashes. Receive and enjoy them, and sort them out patiently as you go along. Look for hidden gems in the projects you already have in place.

With Mercury retrograde in your sign, dear Scorpio, this is an excellent time for looking to the past for answers as well as for refining projects. Early today, a New Moon occurs in your sign, adding forward-looking energy to your life. Something new begins, and it can feel much like a new chapter in your life story. The chances are good that you’ve been feeling ready for a reboot or restart, and this New Moon may very well be it. You’re more visible and personally magnetic, and while it’s a good time to ride this energy, you are inclined to withdraw a little. You’re still attracting attention, and you have increased energy or motivation to bring about needed changes in your life. Something may need to go for you to move forward with less baggage and more confidence. You are getting ready to kick bad habits, start fresh, and present a more self-assured “you” to the world.

Today’s New Moon brings a new beginning or fresh start, dear Sagittarius, but it’s also about your need to recharge before moving forward. There may be some work to do regarding putting a long-standing problem behind you, and you can become aware of the need for more rest and perhaps some special attention to your private life. This begins a new cycle of rest and replenishment. You may be reviewing, recharging, and letting go, both spiritually and physically, in the weeks ahead. Circumstances force your attention to your spiritual needs and mental health at this time of year. Take in rather than push forward. In the coming weeks, you may decide to take action on revelations about the past. A reminder not to jump in too quickly may not be necessary, since you may naturally feel a little hesitant right now. Take the time to sort out your thoughts.

With retrograde Mercury in your friendship sector these days, dear Capricorn, this is a strong time for reconsidering and refining, and ultimately improving, projects and associations. Early today, the New Moon occurs in this same sector of your chart, and this acts as a push forward. Open yourself to the people in your life who offer different perspectives, a change of pace, and exciting variety in your everyday life. Old friendships can re-emerge in the coming week. Your sense of community is strong, and you can find emotional satisfaction through your interactions with, or support for, friends and associates. Memories or surprise meetings can change your perspective. Consider that it’s too soon for brand new beginnings–it’s better to take in than to take action for now. Desires and new endeavors tend to burn out fast if they’re based on whims or are a result of pure restlessness. As the day advances, you enjoy notably interesting and creative interactions.

Today's New Moon can help clear the path for new beginnings, dear Aquarius, particularly related to your life calling, path, career, or status. Career and manifestation are in the spotlight, and you’re likely to feel reinvigorated regarding your goals. There can certainly be some backtracking involved before you see solid or consistent forward movement with Mercury retrograde in the same area of your chart. Still, you’ll begin seeing subtle changes in your life related to your influence or authority, career, status, or reputation as you approach these things with renewed energy and confidence. You have both forward and backward vision, allowing you to really see where you’re coming from and where you’d like to head on the level of your career or life path. This is a time to make important tweaks that improve your professional and public life.

With a New Moon occurring in your spirit sector early today, dear Pisces, over the coming week, you’ll be very focused on expanding your experience and deepening your understanding of your life’s purpose. Because Mercury is retrograde in this same sector, you now have both forward- and backward-looking energy with you. Certainly, inner restlessness is stirring, but the conviction to do something about it should emerge as well, and it can be a strong, motivating force. This can be a time of drawing upon your experience and creating something new from it, or for seeing new layers of a situation that you previously overlooked. Compelling interests and beliefs can emerge now. You’re making a symbolic fresh start by breaking from the past in some manner, and this helps clear the path forward. Avoid making important decisions just for now, though, since it’s still too early to know your precise next step.
